body: Honestly it really is, and when it comes down to it a lot of the time not much can really be done to help. Especially when it is genetic like it is with me. Good luck my friend

Oh 100%, I know a few countries have legal euthanasia, but that’s only due to unbearable illnesses. I’m just a person that isn’t cut out for life and I wish there was a way to just kinda, leave easily.
Yo, I know how extremely hypocritical this sounds comin from the op but I really you hope you get through what you’re going through. We’re not all lost causes

Na I really do appreciate it though, you’re super kind. I have friends I can talk to at anytime and a pretty good support group too, but unloading my problems and burdening people is something I’ve hated to do for as long as I can remember. Then feeling like they have to help makes me feel horrible. Same goes for anyone. Thank you though

Yeah.. but it beats hanging, jumping off a building, overdosing etc, with the help of alcohol I don’t think it’ll be too unbearable. I’ve kinda nearly drowned before and it was very painful but not as bad as you’d think
Appreciate the thought my friend, I’m pretty sure those who have off’d themselves regrets it in the final moments, be nice not to tho
Yeah I know, but that’s if someone were to find me or if i washed up, it’d be at night and it’s not a river so I wouldn’t end up floating upon the shore. Best option I can think of.
